evidence.title: GitHub - Viktorianec/BinaryExplorer: A native macOS app that takes an iOS .ipa apart — byte by byte — and shows you what's actually inside. · GitHub

name: Binary Explorer
summary: Native macOS app that opens iOS .ipa archives and shows bundle, Mach-O, signing, provisioning and resource details.
description: A native macOS app that unpacks iOS .ipa archives and shows what is inside: the bundle tree, Mach-O headers and sections, embedded code signature, provisioning profile, asset catalog and every resource, plus SceneKit 3D maps of where the weight lives. Eleven inspector sections and 30+ automated findings cover distribution, security, size, privacy and configuration. Every parser is hand-written Swift, runs fully offline, and needs macOS 14+ and Xcode 15+ to build.
contains: 11 inspector sections incl. Overview, Structure, Resources, Mach-O, Dependencies, Signing, Privacy & ATS
3 SceneKit 3D views: Bundle City, Binary Strata, Link Constellation
hand-written parsers for ZIP/ZIP64, Mach-O, code signature, provisioning profile and asset catalog
global search across files, libraries, plist keys and entitlements
runs fully offline; macOS 14+ and Xcode 15+ to build
